rationale: The candidate reads coherently across views as a simple split-wing bar, so gesture clarity and repair integrity are decent. The blue frontage edge is acknowledged only weakly: the current split creates a seam, but it does not become a legible court/entry/public ground response. Because the mass is coherent yet semantically underdeveloped, it fails program_fit_hard_pass even though it is not visually broken.
